basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4: basic prices taken directly from source data. Henry Hub is the US wholesale spot price at the hub (EI 2025 Gas Prices sheet, 2022, USD/MMBtu), converted at the PREP gas volume basis of 40 MJ/m3 GCV (40 PJ per bcm) and 1 MMBtu = 1.055056 GJ. EIA's 2022 US pipeline import price from Canada (6.14 USD/Mcf) is the same level.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4. UK NBP day-ahead (EI 2025 Gas Prices sheet, 2022), the UK wholesale price; Eurostat has no UK 2022 data. Same GCV conversion as Henry Hub.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4. Eurostat non-household gas price excluding taxes and levies (X_TAX, the basic-price concept), EUR per GJ GCV, band I3 (10,000-99,999 GJ), Eurostat's medium-size reference consumer, mean of 2022-S1 and 2022-S2. One band for every country so prices are comparable; it covers 31 single-country regions (TOT_GJ covers 21). Applied to single-country regions only; a member of a composite region is not the region's price. Converted at 40 PJ per bcm (PREP gas volume basis) and the 2022 WDI EUR per USD rate. Eurostat's price is paid by the industrial consumer, so it is a purchasers' price excluding taxes: basic = price / (1 + MR) by GTAP 12 ch.12 eq.(2) with the tax zero and the Table 12.8 industrial margin rate (gas 1.30, electricity 0).

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4. Eurostat non-household electricity price excluding taxes and levies (X_TAX), EUR per kWh, band ID (2,000-19,999 MWh), Eurostat's medium-size reference consumer, mean of 2022-S1 and 2022-S2. Covers 35 single-country regions (TOT_KWH covers 32). Single-country regions only. EUR per kWh x 1000 / (EUR per USD 2022) = USD/MWh. Eurostat's price is paid by the industrial consumer, so it is a purchasers' price excluding taxes: basic = price / (1 + MR) by GTAP 12 ch.12 eq.(2) with the tax zero and the Table 12.8 industrial margin rate (gas 1.30, electricity 0).

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4. EIA Annual Coal Report 2022 table 28, US average sales price of coal at the mine, all mine types (USD per short ton, free on board mine), divided by 0.90718474 t per short ton. A mine-gate (basic) price, so no margin is removed.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4. EIA Electric Power Annual 2022 table 2.4, average price of electricity to industrial customers, total electric industry (US cents per kWh), x 10 = USD/MWh. Industrial rather than all-sector because energy sold to firms is the bulk of GTAP ely sales and the retail residential price carries distribution to households. A purchasers' price before taxes; GTAP Table 12.8 sets the electricity margin to 0, so it is also the basic price.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4: basic prices taken directly from source data. AECO-C is the Alberta wholesale hub price, the Canadian counterpart of Henry Hub (AER ST98 2024 workbook, sheet Tables, Table S1.2, 2022 actual from the Canadian Gas Price Reporter, 5.10 CAD/GJ; the 2023 edition agrees). Converted at the WDI PA.NUS.FCRF CAN 2022 rate and 40 PJ per bcm. A hub price, so no margin is removed, and it keeps its place ahead of the IEA gap as Henry Hub does (David, 2026-10-23 20:13). StatCan 25-10-0059 delivered values (Alberta industrial 3.87 CAD/GJ) are below the hub price and may cover distribution only, so they are not used.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4: basic price from source data. David chose to use an observed 2022 average for China coal (decision card 2026-10-23 20:52 UTC+7, row china_coal_price). NBS China Statistical Yearbook 2023: coal mining and washing operating revenue 40,729.4 (1e8 RMB, ex VAT, producer) over raw coal output 45.59 (1e8 t) = 893 RMB/t, at WDI PA.NUS.FCRF CHN 2022. The counterpart of the US mine-gate average (EIA ACR); a producer price, so no margin is removed, and it keeps its place ahead of the import price as the US mine price does (David 20:13). An upper bound for thermal coal at the mine: it includes washed and coking coal and some non-coal revenue of coal firms (logged as S11-24). config/s11/nbs_coal_2022.csv holds the transcription.

decided_by: Claude (S11 thread)
basis: GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.4 and §12.3.9: basic prices from source data, products share-weighted by volume. EIA 2022 spot prices FOB (data/eia_prices/EIA_PET_PRI_SPT_S1_A.xls): US Gulf Coast conventional regular gasoline, ultra-low-sulfur diesel and kerosene-type jet fuel, and Mont Belvieu propane, x 42 gal/bbl, weighted by 2022 US refinery and blender net production (data/eia_us_2022/PET_SUM_SND_D_NUS_MBBL_A_CUR.xls: finished motor gasoline, distillate fuel oil, kerosene-type jet fuel, propane), about 131.4 USD/bbl. Refinery output rather than product supplied because the price values refinery output, and gas-plant propane is already priced as the NGPL add-on (Grok QA 3 of S11, 2026-10-23; product supplied gave 127.67). Wholesale prices at the hub, so no margin is removed. Residual fuel oil, coke, asphalt, still gas and lubricants (11.4 percent of 2022 refinery output) have no EIA spot price and are left out (S11-25). Replaces the net-exporter class average for US petroleum (Grok QA 2 of S11, 2026-10-23); the simple mean of the three light products (137.65) was replaced after S11 QA B5.

decided_by: Claude (beta v4 fix thread); FIX_REGISTER P16, David's call (applies only where choice prk_coal_price is on)
basis: Beta v4 P16, labelled departure from GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.3.6 p.20 (the four-class fill), used only where s11_choices.csv prk_coal_price is on. PRK has no observed coal price; the four-class fill gives about 315 USD/t on 21.65 Mt, so domestic coal sales are 6.8 bn and PRK construction carries 41% of its cost as coal (energy_routing_trace/TRACE_REPORT.md P16). The row prices PRK coal at the NBS 2022 China mine unit value used for CHN (893 RMB/t ex VAT, about 133 USD/t; config/s11/nbs_coal_2022.csv), the nearest observed mine price: PRK anthracite was sold almost only to China before the 2017 UN ban. The NDRC 303 contract range is not used, as for CHN (choice china_coal_price). An upper bound for a mine-gate price, like the CHN row.

decided_by: Claude (beta v4 readiness pass); FIX_REGISTER P2, David's call (applies only where choice zaf_power_coal_price is on)
basis: Beta v4 P2, labelled departure. GTAP 12 keeps one basic price per commodity across use classes (§12.3 p.14, §12.3.8 p.21); today ZAF has no coal source row and its coal is priced at export parity (about 192 USD/t), so Eskom, which burns about 102 Mt of the roughly 180 Mt of domestic coal sales, buys at export parity and power VA collapses (ely_va_diagnosis F3). The row sets ZAF's single domestic coal price at Eskom's cost per tonne burned (616 ZAR/t delivered, transport and handling included, about 37.7 USD/t at the WDI 2022 rate; Eskom FY2023, nine months in 2022; transcribed_prices_2022.csv zaf_eskom_coal_2022, primary sources), following ind_coal_pithead_2022. Departure: one class price (power) stands for all domestic users; the non-power users (Sasol's own mines, industry) are also mostly on mine-gate contracts, so the bias is small.
